test_plan.route: GitHub contents create/fetch/update with blob-SHA compare-and-swap in role-local namespace
test_plan.step_1: Durably create and read back this precommit.
test_plan.step_2: Update this exact path once using the read-back PRECOMMIT blob SHA.
test_plan.step_3: Retry the exact same final content using the now-stale PRECOMMIT blob SHA; safe behavior is rejection rather than a second commit.
test_plan.step_4: Read back the path and verify the one committed final blob remains authoritative.

scope: Only this repository, this role-local path, and the exposed GitHub contents CAS route. This does not prove behavior for other sinks/backends or an actual HTTP 429 rate-limit event.
